resources.string: Orbit turns the dial on your CMF Buds Pro 2 case into a controller. Double-press the dial to open a wheel of tools, turn to pick, press to select; turning then scrolls, zooms, changes brightness or switches apps. This service draws the wheel on screen and performs those actions (scroll gestures, zoom, back/home/recents, screenshots, opening apps). It only acts when you use the dial. It does not read or store the content of your screen, with two exceptions: the name of the app in front, to offer recent apps in the Apps tool, and, only when you press the dial with the Camera tool, the buttons of the camera app in front, to find and press its shutter. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
